name: CLI Host
responsibility: Command parsing, help, completion, exit codes, cancellation, stdout/stderr discipline.

name: Configuration
responsibility: Layered configuration, schema validation, profiles, redaction, effective-config reporting.

name: Capability Probe
responsibility: Detect OS, filesystem, codecs, runtimes, models, native tools, and operation-specific support.

name: Input Discovery
responsibility: Deterministic traversal, filters, response files, identities, aliases, reparse and cloud-file policy.

name: Metadata Service
responsibility: Read/write governed metadata through ExifTool adapter; orientation semantics; metadata diff and policy.

name: Codec Service
responsibility: Bounded decode, thumbnails, format capability matrix, safe encode, image property inspection.

name: Transform Service
responsibility: Compose EXIF and inferred transforms; JPEG DCT transforms; raster transforms; output normalization.

name: Inference Runtime
responsibility: Run pinned ONNX models through a provider-agnostic interface and expose deterministic tensors/results.

name: Model Registry
responsibility: Manifest, digests, compatibility, install, quarantine, activation, rollback, provenance.

name: Orientation Feature Extractor
responsibility: Convert detections/landmarks into interpretable rotation evidence and multi-face summaries.

name: Confidence Calibration
responsibility: Map evidence to calibrated probabilities and uncertainty diagnostics for a policy version.

name: Decision Policy
responsibility: Apply thresholds, margins, evidence rules, metadata priors, sequence tie-breakers, and abstention.

name: Orientation Engine
responsibility: Generate candidates, orchestrate inference/features/policy, and emit explainable decisions.

name: Planner
responsibility: Create immutable plans, resolve destinations, detect unsupported operations, and seal provenance.

name: Pipeline Coordinator
responsibility: Bounded channels, work scheduling, resource classes, cancellation, retries, and stage metrics.

name: Apply Executor
responsibility: Preflight, transform, metadata update, verify, commit, retry, resume, and undo orchestration.

name: Independent Verifier
responsibility: Reopen outputs, compare expected geometry/orientation/metadata/digests, and classify verification failures.

name: Filesystem Safety Layer
responsibility: Canonical paths, handles/identity, temp placement, flush, atomic replace, backups, locks, aliases, placeholders.

name: Recovery Journal
responsibility: Write-ahead intents, state transitions, commit records, recovery reconciliation, and undo provenance.

name: Job Store
responsibility: SQLite-backed jobs, manifests, plans, events, decisions, checkpoints, schema migrations, integrity.

name: Review Workflow
responsibility: Queue uncertain items, render evidence/thumbnail references, validate imported decisions, append overrides.

name: Events and Reporting
responsibility: Structured events, human rendering, JSON/JSONL, summaries, diagnostics bundles, redaction.

name: Benchmark Harness
responsibility: Micro, pipeline, corpus, and environment-aware benchmarks with comparable result manifests.

name: Native Tool Adapter
responsibility: Hardened process/native-library invocation, version probes, stderr capture, timeouts, cancellation, sandbox policy.
